How Ordering Works

Four clear steps from first message to delivery.

Details
  1. 1

    Tell us what you need

    Product, quantity, destination port and packing — on WhatsApp or with the quote form.

  2. 2

    Get a price

    FOB Chattogram, CFR or CIF, by sea or air, usually the same day.

  3. 3

    We source and pack

    Graded at the farm, packed to your spec, photos and video before loading.

  4. 4

    Shipped with papers

    Phytosanitary certificate, invoice, packing list and bill of lading or airway bill.
